subject.title: fix(onboarding): stop recommending tools setup cannot activate

question: Should the shared no-AI onboarding catalog recommend only tools that guided setup can detect and turn into a verified inference route, rather than all separately supported coding-agent tools?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically narrow, but the merged feature did not establish whether these cards are guided-setup actions or broader provider-discovery links; choosing that meaning changes all client surfaces.

options.title: Limit cards to guided setup
options.body: Merge this PR and make verified guided-setup eligibility the catalog rule across CLI, macOS, and web.

options.title: Retain broader discovery
options.body: Keep the existing catalog if the empty state is intentionally meant to advertise tools whose setup continues through separate advanced flows.

recommendation.title: Limit cards to guided setup
recommendation.body: Merge this PR and make verified guided-setup eligibility the catalog rule across CLI, macOS, and web.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the shared catalog and its cross-client onboarding contract in the merged feature work.
